chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man whose garment comes into contact with the body of the dead person. He said: He should wash whatever of the garment was touched.
ai.seo_question: What should be done if a garment touches the body of a dead person according to a hadith in al-Istibṣār?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a garment that comes into contact with the body of a dead person. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that the part of the garment affected by that contact should be washed, indicating a ruling connected to ritual purity.
